# Town of Norwich municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 17; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Norwich, official marked ballot, March 3, 2026 town meeting election (954 voters): Peter Orner was elected moderator with 851 votes
Town of Norwich, official marked ballot, March 3, 2026 town meeting election (954 voters): Lily C. Trajman was elected town clerk for a three-year term with 874 votes
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): names Lily Trajman as Norwich's town clerk

Town of Norwich, official marked ballot, March 3, 2026 town meeting election (954 voters): Cheryl A. Lindberg was elected to the office the ballot titles 'Town and School District Treasurer' for a three-year term with 834 votes; it is modeled here as the town treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): names Cheryl Lindberg as Norwich's town treasurer

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists the Norwich selectboard: Brendan Classon, Robert Gere, James Griggs, Mary Layton, and Matthew Swett

Town of Norwich, official marked ballot, March 3, 2026 town meeting election (954 voters): Brendan Classon was elected to a three-year seat with 732 votes; the two-year seat had no printed candidate and the ballot's own handwritten write-in tally reads 'GERE: 342 SMITH: 290', making Robert Gere the certified write-in winner; James Griggs, Mary Layton, and Matthew Swett did not stand and continue

Town of Norwich, official marked ballot, March 3, 2026 town meeting election (954 voters): Cheryl Lindberg was elected lister with 803 votes; the two-year unexpired seat drew 41 write-in votes with no winner declared, and no source read names the third seat's holder, so two seats are created without memberships
Town of Norwich, Listers page: names only the chair, Cheryl Lindberg

Town of Norwich, Cemetery Commission page: the commission has five members, one elected each year: Bob Pitiger (term to 2027), Ellen Terie (term to 2028), Dan Goulet (term to 2029), Alix Manny (term to 2030), and Bob Bristol (term to 2031)
Town of Norwich, official marked ballot, March 3, 2026 town meeting election (954 voters): Bob Bristol was elected cemetery commissioner with 813 votes

Town of Norwich, official marked ballot, March 3, 2026 town meeting election (954 voters): Christie James was elected trustee of public funds for a two-year unexpired term with 764 votes and Pamela T Smith for a one-year unexpired term with 675 votes; the three-year seat drew 25 write-in votes with no winner declared, so it is created without a membership

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): Norwich elects twelve justices of the peace; the listing names Jedediah Baker, Frances R De Gasta, Corlan Johnson, Suzanne Leiter, Kristin Maffei, Alix Manny, Robert E. Pitiger, Emily Scherer, Dianne Amme, David Krimmel, Arline Rotman, and Ernest Ciccotelli
